summary: GalaxyEdge Acquisition Corp (a SPAC) filed an 8-K announcing a business combination agreement with Rongcheng Group Limited. Pursuant to the merger, GLED will merge into a subsidiary (Purchaser), and Merger Sub will merge with Rongcheng, making Rongcheng a wholly owned subsidiary of Purchaser. Existing GLED shareholders receive one Purchaser share per GLED share. Rongcheng shareholders receive 35,000,000 Purchaser shares valued at $10.00 per share ($350 million aggregate). The SPAC merger and acquisition merger occur concurrently. No board recommendation or advisor was named. Watch for shareholder approval, the SPAC redemption deadline, and any impact from trust proceeds on the final valuation.
